facts.fact: Ashton 满身泥冲进厨房讨烈酒，Brooks 替她解释 cowgirl glitter。
facts.anchor: “S’not dirt,” she argues with a pout. I know she’s grumpy, but it’s kind of adorable

facts.fact: 回忆：她学 Jody 跳草垛脱手砸在木地板上。
facts.anchor: She makes the same jump Jody did, reaching out and grazing her hands along the rope, before losing grip and dropping to the floor

facts.fact: Jody 发明 cowgirl glitter 并从她头发里拣出稻草。
facts.anchor: “It’s not dirt,” Jody says kindly, picking a piece of straw from her hair and tossing it on the ground. “It’s cowgirl glitter.”

facts.fact: 小 Brooks 从没听过 cowgirl glitter，但只要 Jody 说了他就信——她笑了，他的胃结就松开。
facts.anchor: I’ve never heard of cowgirl glitter before, but if Jody said it, it’s probably true.

facts.fact: Ev 说 Ruth 是他老婆、我的就是她的。
facts.anchor: New York. Last loose ends to tie up from her old job. She’ll be back tomorrow. Anyway, she’s my wife

facts.fact: 她听说 Loggins 披萨时整张脸亮起来。
facts.anchor: “You got Loggins?” Ashton’s face lights up and I can’t help but grin back.

facts.fact: 他喊她锁门，她比了个单指礼。
facts.anchor: “Lock your doors, Tanner!” I yell. She raises a hand in a one-fingered salute without turning around

facts.fact: 他知道她要来，整个身体因期待而嗡鸣、冒出想留最好印象的怪念头。
facts.anchor: But something about knowing Ashton is on her way over has my whole body buzzing with anticipation, and a strange desire to make the best impression.

facts.fact: 她走后他进她的厨房——Everett/Jody 帮她搬过家具、Ashton 用「测试烤箱」烤了他最爱的白巧 macadamia 曲奇。
facts.anchor: The day I moved in, Ev and Jody helped me move the furniture around, and Ashton “tested” the oven in my kitchen by baking my favorite kind of cookies: white chocolate macadamia.
